findings.evidence: Mathlib/Data/Set/Operations.lean:284 defines `mapsTo_image (f) (s) : MapsTo f s (f '' s)`; the new proof is exactly `rw [← hfim]; exact mem_image_of_mem f hz`.
findings.fix: Remove it and use `hfim ▸ Set.mapsTo_image f Ω` (applied to the membership proof), or `(image_eq_iff_surjOn_mapsTo.mp hfim).2`.
findings.issue: `mem_ball_of_image_eq_ball` is a thin restatement of `Set.mapsTo_image` under an image equality.

findings.evidence: Domain.lean:223 is exactly `hyperbolicDistOn_image hΩo hΩo hΩ hφ hφi hφim hz hw`.
findings.fix: Remove the wrapper and have consumers invoke `hyperbolicDistOn_image hΩo hΩo hΩ hφ hφi hφim hz hw` directly.
findings.issue: `hyperbolicDistOn_self_image` is only the `Ω' = Ω` specialization of the public `hyperbolicDistOn_image`, with no additional conclusion.

summary: Two public declarations duplicate existing generic or immediately preceding API without adding reusable content.
